5.0.SP2.description: Code to identify the desired frequency of progress reports.

values.1: Buy-side explicitly requests status using Statue Request (default), the sell-side firm can, however, send a DONE status List Status <N> Response in an unsolicited fashion
values.2: Sell-side periodically sends status using List Status. Period optionally specified in ProgressPeriod.
